solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing; clues and answers read from cryptics.georgeho.org (ODbL)'s copy of the post

clue.text: Assistant paediatrician shows up

indicators.note: the word shows its letters openly, sitting inside the longer medical word
in a down clue, 'up' means the run of letters is read from bottom to top

blocks.note: four consecutive letters inside the word, starting at its third letter

explanation.surface: A doctor's helper in a children's clinic turns up for work.
explanation.walkthrough: EDIA sits in paEDIAtrician; read upwards it gives AIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: An aide is a helper or assistant, typically to someone senior such as a minister or officer.

clue.text: Goddess with little twins

blocks.note: Ge, also Gaia, is the Greek goddess of the earth
mini means small

explanation.surface: A deity accompanied by a pair of small twin children.
explanation.definitionFit: Gemini is the zodiac sign and constellation of the Twins, Castor and Pollux, from the Latin word for twins.

clue.text: Gulls shed feathers at start of September

indicators.note: only the very first letter of the following month's name is wanted

blocks.note: to mew is an old word for a bird moulting
the opening letter of the month

explanation.surface: Seabirds moult as autumn begins in September.
explanation.walkthrough: MEW also means a gull, so the definition is plural MEWS; the feathers verb is a falconry term, hence mews where hawks were kept while moulting.
explanation.definitionFit: A mew is a seagull, especially the common gull, so mews are several of the seabirds.

clue.text: Arab staked outside is changed

indicators.note: the gambling verb wraps around the outside of the short word for the Arab

blocks.note: vied means competed or gambled, as when staking a bet in old card games
Ar. is the abbreviation for Arab or Arabic

explanation.surface: A tethered Arab horse is behaving differently.
explanation.walkthrough: To vie once meant to stake a wager in old card games; 'Arab' looks like the horse but only lends its abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Varied means altered or modified, as with a varied programme that has been changed from the original.

clue.text: Weapon the French installed is beginning to terrify one easily scared

indicators.note: the French article is set into the weapon word, as a fitting is put inside something
only the first letter of the following word is kept

blocks.note: an arm is a weapon, as in firearm
la is French for 'the' before a feminine noun
taken as written
the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A French-held weapon is starting to scare a nervous person.
explanation.walkthrough: The article goes inside the weapon after its first letter, not around it, which is the step that is easy to miss.
explanation.definitionFit: An alarmist is a person who panics or spreads needless fear, so readily frightened by small threats.

clue.text: Largo and a bit of lento modified becoming largo

indicators.note: a small bit of the tempo word, its first letter, is all that is used
the letters are altered in order, so they are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A musical instruction about tempo markings, slow pieces altered to become even slower.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'Largo' is fodder; the second, in the definition, is the tempo marking for a slow, broad pace.
explanation.definitionFit: Allargando is an Italian musical direction meaning broadening, gradually slowing and growing fuller toward a stately, slow pace.

clue.text: First class dealer trained terrier

indicators.note: something trained has been reshaped and drilled into a new form

blocks.note: A1 means first class, written with I for the figure one
taken as written

explanation.surface: A top-class trader has a well-trained dog.
explanation.definitionFit: The Airedale is the largest breed of terrier, named after the valley of the River Aire in Yorkshire.

clue.text: Adult for example brought up minor like Peter Pan

indicators.note: in a down entry, raising letters up means reading them from bottom to top

blocks.note: A is the film certificate for adult
e.g. is the abbreviation for 'for example'
lesser or smaller, as in minor

explanation.surface: A grown-up, for instance, raised a child like the boy who never grew up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' reads as raising a child, but in a down clue it turns the abbreviation upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Peter Pan is J. M. Barrie's boy who never grows up, so he is ageless, untouched by the passing years.

clue.text: Gene, everybody else has lost

indicators.note: the word has lost the 's that stands for has, the clitic contraction

blocks.note: all means everyone
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gene that everyone else is missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' can be contracted to 's, so 'else has lost' means the word drops its S.
explanation.definitionFit: An allele is one of the alternative forms of a gene found at the same place on a chromosome; loosely a gene.

clue.text: Make one’s home on border

blocks.note: re means on or concerning
a side is an edge or border

explanation.surface: Settling down to live on the frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: To reside is to dwell or live permanently somewhere, setting up house there.

clue.text: Foolish prodigals drop their sixth approach to motorway

indicators.note: foolish behaviour is muddled, so the letters are jumbled
the sixth letter of the spendthrifts' word is let fall

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Foolish spendthrifts give up their sixth chance at something.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing G, the sixth letter, from PRODIGALS leaves PRODIALS for the shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip road is the short road by which traffic joins or leaves a motorway in Britain, an on-ramp.

clue.text: Afters at No. 10

blocks.note: surface: the dessert served at the Prime Minister's residence
setter's reading: the government's senior ministers meet at No. 10, and their name is also that of a steamed sponge dessert

explanation.walkthrough: No. 10 Downing Street is the British Prime Minister's home, where the Cabinet meets. Afters is British slang for dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: Cabinet pudding is a traditional British steamed dessert of sponge, dried fruit and custard, punningly the ministers' sweet course.

clue.text: A zebra shot on New Year’s Day in Asian state

indicators.note: shot means ruined or wrecked, so the animal's letters are broken up

blocks.note: taken as written
1 January, written as I for one and JAN

explanation.surface: A zebra is shot on the first of January somewhere in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is part of the surface but just places 1 JAN after the shuffled animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Azerbaijan is a former Soviet republic in the Caucasus on the Caspian Sea, often counted as an Asian country.

clue.text: Acceptable in stiffly formal Jewish feast

indicators.note: one item placed in another means the first sits inside the second

blocks.note: prim means stiffly correct
U means upper-class and so socially acceptable

explanation.surface: Proper behaviour at a strictly formal religious festival.
explanation.walkthrough: U goes into PRIM: PR(U)IM. U for acceptable comes from the 1950s U and non-U usage debate.
explanation.definitionFit: Purim is the Jewish festival celebrating the deliverance of the Jews in Persia, told in the Book of Esther.

clue.text: Exorcist forgetting his last prayer for Wordsworth

indicators.note: the cleric forgets his final letter, which is dropped

blocks.note: a benet is an exorcist, the third of the minor orders of the Church

explanation.surface: A priest who casts out demons forgets the end of a prayer.
explanation.walkthrough: BENET loses its T. Wordsworth used the rare word bene to mean a prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Bene is an archaic word for a prayer or petition, found in Wordsworth's poetry, so it fits the poet's usage.

clue.text: Someone dying examined by doctor in part

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are altered

blocks.note: ex. is a dictionary abbreviation for examined
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dying patient partly checked over by a physician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' looks like a noun, the examining physician, but it is a verb telling you to rework the last two words.
explanation.definitionFit: An expirant is a person who is breathing their last, from expire meaning to die.

clue.text: Island starting to sell Scots shirts

indicators.note: only the starting letter of the next word is used

blocks.note: Sark is one of the Channel Islands
the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: An island beginning to sell shirts to Scots.
explanation.definitionFit: Sark is a Scottish and northern dialect word for a shirt or chemise, so sarks are shirts.

clue.text: Colour’s very loud in Nora’s dressing

indicators.note: dressing arranges things anew, as a window is dressed, so the name's letters are rearranged
the loud marking goes in, placed inside the rearranged name

blocks.note: taken as written
ff, fortissimo, is the musical direction for very loud

explanation.surface: A garish colour in Nora's outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: The musical marking is split into the middle of the rearranged name, not tacked on.
explanation.definitionFit: Saffron is a deep orange-yellow colour, named after the spice made from crocus stigmas.

clue.text: Wait for time to close

blocks.note: T is the abbreviation for time
the close of something is its end

explanation.surface: Waiting for closing time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wait for time to close' reads as a phrase, but 'Wait' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To tend is to attend or wait on someone, as a waiter or servant does; it is also an old word for waiting.

clue.text: Christening in Transylvania

blocks.note: surface: a baptism ceremony held in a Romanian region
setter's reading: Transylvania is Dracula's home, so a vampire's initiation would involve gore rather than water

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase really means martyrdom of an unbaptised believer, counted as baptism; the clue plays on Transylvanian vampire lore.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names martyrdom treated as a christening, which literal-minded vampires of Dracula's homeland would relish.

clue.text: Diligently applied in camp

blocks.note: taken as written
a tent is the shelter of a camp, so being in camp is being in a tent

explanation.surface: Hard work carried out at a campsite.
explanation.definitionFit: Intent as an adjective means earnestly focused or absorbed, as in intent on one's studies.

clue.text: Conducted vessel inside and had fun

indicators.note: one element is placed inside the other, enclosed by it

blocks.note: led means guided or conducted
an ark is a vessel, like Noah's

explanation.surface: Someone steered a boat and enjoyed themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conducted vessel' reads as sailing a ship, but the boat word simply sits inside the past tense of lead.
explanation.definitionFit: To lark about is to play pranks or frolic, so someone who larked was enjoying themselves mischievously.

clue.text: Tie great complex feathery ornament

indicators.note: complex means intricate, tangled, so the letters are intertwined in another order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A splendid tie with an elaborate plumed decoration.
explanation.definitionFit: An aigrette is a tuft of egret plumes or a jewelled spray worn as a headdress or hat decoration.

clue.text: Fruit cut for every one individually

indicators.note: the fruit is cut, losing its head letter

blocks.note: a peach is a fruit

explanation.surface: Fruit sliced so that everyone gets a piece.
explanation.walkthrough: PEACH loses its first letter, P.
explanation.definitionFit: Each, as an adverb, means apiece or to every one separately, as in tickets cost five pounds each.

clue.text: Earl leaves position behind City seldom

indicators.note: the nobleman departs, so his letter is taken away

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for earl
the rear is the position at the back
Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire

explanation.surface: A nobleman departs his place behind the City only seldom.
explanation.walkthrough: Ely is a small cathedral city in Cambridgeshire and a crossword favourite for 'City'.
explanation.definitionFit: Rarely and seldom are straightforward synonyms, meaning not often or only on infrequent occasions.

clue.text: Escape death in operation

blocks.note: first meaning: to survive, to stay alive
second meaning: switched on and working, as a wire carrying current

explanation.surface: Surviving while under the surgeon's knife.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means to survive and stay alive; as an adjective it means active or carrying current.

clue.text: Rule about new ordnance

indicators.note: about means around, so the regulation wraps round the other letter

blocks.note: a canon is a rule or law, especially of the church
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A regulation concerning new military equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: CANON goes around N: CAN(N)ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordnance is military artillery, and a cannon is a large mounted gun firing heavy shot.

clue.text: Keep prisoner to wait at table

blocks.note: a con is a convict
to serve food to diners

explanation.surface: Keeping a convict on to work as a waiter.
explanation.definitionFit: To conserve is to preserve or protect something from loss or waste, maintaining it.
